bayts.text: O Allah, O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), bless with peace him for whose sake this speech is (addressed) to You,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And guard, by his immense rank, my creed from faults, and protect me from the burning.
O Allah, O Withholder of harm (Al-Māniʿ), bless with peace him through whom You spared me blame,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And shield, by his immense rank, my heart from faults, and protect me from despoiling.
O Allah, O All-Sufficient (Al-Kāfī), make lasting the best blessing, with peace, for him whose loftiness grows,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And spare me, with a sparing that gladdens, before it heads (for me), all that harms.
O Allah, O One (Al-Aḥad), bless with peace him for whose sake the pens (go) to You from me,
our master, our intercessor Muḥammad, his Family, his Companions and the praisers.
And make my creeds, by his immense rank, pure, and accept with thanks this composition through him.
O Allah, O Worshipped One, bless for ever him who called on You and worshipped You,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me, by his rank, Islam, and give success to (my) thought and (my) pens.
O Allah, O Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), bless for ever him whose life has been praised,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me sincerity for the Gardens, through him, and illumine for me, through him, my heart.
O Allah, O best of lovers and of the beloved, O You Who made the Select One the most beloved to You,
bless, grant peace and send blessing for ever upon him, with the Family and those who have been praised
among his Companions and all the righteous; and through him make my life good pleasure and piety.
O Allah, O You Who led Your love to me together with the love of Your beloved, who gathered all good,
bless, grant peace and send blessing at every time upon Your beloved, the beloved of the righteous,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And with You make me beloved of Allah, beloved of the most excellent of creation, by Allah.
O Allah, O Doer, O Chooser, O You with Whom is all that is chosen,
bless and grant peace for ever upon the Trustworthy, our master Muḥammad, he who does not lie,
upon his Family and his Companions; and grant me a triumph for which those before me will (holily) envy me,
in You and in him: truly You are the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), O You through Whom terror has not headed toward me.
O Allah, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), bless for ever and grant peace upon the Bearer of good news, Aḥmad,
upon his Family and his Companions, in the present and the final outcome, O Establisher of every state.
O You Who lead good to my quarters, O You Who, through Yourself, free my hand from (saying) "give me",
bless and grant peace for ever upon the Prophet, hope of every kinsman and stranger,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And spare me the terrors of the Day of Gathering, and be for me eternally with joy.
And make, for Your noble Face, my pen the best ladder for those who learn.
And guide us through You on the straight path, and free us, with what is sound, from what is sick.
And guard us from straying and leading astray, and lead to us, with good pleasure, the lawful.
O Allah, O Maker (Al-Bāriʾ), bless with peace him (through whom) You protected me from blame,
by the rank of our master Muḥammad, his Family and the praising Companions.
And grant me the Book, spare me faults and teach me through it the best of mysteries.
And make firm faith, steadfastness (in prayer) and good character, with uprightness.
And grant me guidance, make success everlasting for me, spare me doubts and draw righteousness to me.
O Allah, O Generous, bless for ever and grant peace upon a Prophet who worshipped
and led others to worship; and grant me, by his rank, benefit.
Adorn, by Your being the Beautiful, my outward and my inward, O Manifester of manifestations.
O Allah, O Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), bless with peace him to whom I have given, in You, the pens,
our master Muḥammad, he whose equal has not been seen in what has passed, nor shall be seen,
upon his Family and the Companions, and grant peace; and lead glad tidings to him in my pen.
O Allah, O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), bless for ever, with Your peace, him who has been praised,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And be for me with an increase of good and gain, with beauty and permanence in what is lawful.
And accept with thanks my letters in the measure of the Essence, in praise of him who was brought near with delights.
O excellent one, whom the Creator made excellent, O you through whom destitution left me,
I have turned to you today, and the Provider (Ar-Razzāq) has been for me with that by which provisions grow.
You erased from me that by which hypocrisy vanished from me, and the prosperity of trade came to me.
You returned to me what concord had adorned, through him by whom the horizons were illumined.
Good pleasure, triumph and emancipation have come through you, just as through you the noble have risen.
Through you we have attained what we long for: may the Most Generous, the Creator, bless you.
O Allah, bless and grant peace for ever upon the Arab Prophet, Aḥmad,
upon his Family and his Companions; and send every harm toward a direction other than mine, that it may go.
O Allah, bless and grant peace eternally upon him who led to You whoever worships,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And teach me through him, instruct me (in the Law), spare me all harm and awaken me.
And turn good pleasure toward me, and drive toward others than me every evil that may be driven off.
O Allah, O Doer, O Chooser, bless him whose name is al-Mukhtār (the Chosen),
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions; and teach my heart.
And choose good for me in everything, O Enricher, making all of me free of harm.
And free me, by the right of Your noble Face, from harm, and be for me with what I seek.
